rows.candidate_origin: R391 fresh full-universe diverse cluster / candidate universe rank 11908 / diverse rank 1
rows.evidence_boundary: deterministic synthetic mechanism evidence only; no empirical finance, deployment or novel-theory claim
rows.mechanism_removing_comparator: same CAPL-style optimizer, data, random seed, turnover/risk/cost settings and validation objective with uniform base asset caps; REIS selection no longer changes the feasible set

nearest_existing_products.difference: BMCAPL contracts one global turnover bound from belief tipping distance; REICAPL creates heterogeneous per-asset caps from consequence-aware evidence safeguard allocation.
SACAPL changes covariance risk geometry inside CAPL objective; REICAPL changes asset-specific feasible caps without covariance substitution.
REIS allocates safeguard budget but does not learn a portfolio policy or alter CAPL action constraints.
CAPL uses one uniform maximum asset weight; REICAPL makes that feasible geometry heterogeneous using upstream REIS selection.

rows.new_failure_mode: CAPL can allocate excessive exposure to an asset tied to a low-posterior but high-consequence evidence record when uniform caps ignore REIS consequence-aware safeguard priority.
rows.non_additive_interaction: REIS posterior×consequence safeguard selection is converted into heterogeneous per-asset feasible caps before CAPL-style optimization, changing the feasible action geometry and learned validation action path rather than appending an audit report.
rows.posterior_only_ablation: same heterogeneous-cap mechanism but safeguard allocation uses posterior probability only, removing REIS consequence weighting
rows.sensitivity_boundary: benefit is conditional, not universal: at adverse_shift=-0.002 the fresh 3-seed sweep has 0/3 positive removal-control gains, while -0.010, -0.015 and -0.020 have 3/3 positive gains
rows.support_boundary: record-to-asset semantic alignment is externally declared and must cover every REIS record; missing or unknown mappings fail closed rather than being inferred from returns
rows.working_region: explicit record-to-asset alignment is correct and the consequence-selected asset enters a sufficiently adverse validation shift relative to training

rules: visibility expansion is not itself product promotion
executable suite does not imply distinct family
new failure + non-additive interaction + nearest-family comparison + mechanism-removal control required
mechanics telemetry calibrates executable contracts only
current test signature, not an older pilot signature, controls calibration authority
